item.title: Dems vow to force weekly Iran war votes after GOP blocks latest move to curb Trump
item.summary: Senate Republicans blocked another war powers resolution, this time from Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., as Democrats vow to force at least one vote per week.

item.title: FBI’s ‘Operation Box Cutter’ indicts Chinese pharma firms, terror-linked cartel assets in fentanyl takedown
item.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel revealed a historic crackdown on Chinese pharmaceutical companies allegedly supplying the Gulf cartel with fentanyl precursors.

item.title: Chicago activist torches Dem crime policies after Loyola student's murder: 'How much more can we take?'
item.summary: Chicago activist P-Rae Easley pleaded with President Donald Trump to save Chicago after Loyola University student Sheridan Gorman was allegedly killed by an illegal immigrant.

item.title: TSA warns shutdown is forcing some workers to draw blood to pay for gas
item.summary: Deputy TSA Administrator Stahl said agents are selling blood plasma and sleeping in cars as the 38-day shutdown left 50,000 workers without pay.

item.title: NJ Gov. Sherrill attends mosque led by Imam once accused of Hamas ties in deportation case
item.summary: NJ Gov. Mikie Sherrill attended a Ramadan event at a Paterson mosque led by Imam Mohammad Qatanani, who allegedly has ties to Hamas and fought deportation for years.

item.title: Ballot box upset: Democrats flip Florida legislative seat in Trump’s stomping ground
item.summary: Trump-endorsed Republican Jon Maples loses to Democrat Emily Gregory in a Florida House District 87 special election in Palm Beach, home to President Donald Trump

item.title: Pritzker's glowing review of lakefront resurfaces after college student killed by illegal alien nearby
item.summary: Footage from Gov. JB Pritzker's cheerful lakefront video clashed with reality in the wake of Sheridan Gorman's death at the hands of a Venezuelan national.

item.title: NBPA calls out tanking as Bucks weigh Giannis Antetokounmpo shutdown
item.summary: Despite sitting outside the playoff picture, Giannis Antetokounmpo reportedly wants to play, while the Bucks prefer he sit out, prompting a response from the players’ union.

item.title: Upcoming book reveals Trump admired Queen Elizabeth for being the 'opposite of me' in one key diplomatic skill
item.summary: Donald Trump recalls being dazzled by Queen Elizabeth II's diplomatic tact in "The Queen and Her Presidents," saying her refusal to criticize anyone was "genius."

item.title: California university cancels gubernatorial debate after backlash for all White candidates
item.summary: USC canceled a planned California gubernatorial debate for Tuesday after candidate Xavier Becerra accused the university of excluding candidates of color.
